machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. Ticket exists — DONE.** Created ticket titled `fwrd93-n1 RD Bench Ticket`, reference **RD-1015** (detail page `/#/tickets/t15`), customer "Blue Fox Cafe", initial status Draft.

**2. Part A — DONE.** Part `fwrd93-n1 RD Part A`, cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1, supplier "Widgets Ltd". App-computed price: **$125.00** (parts total $125.00).

**3. Part B — DONE.** Part `fwrd93-n1 RD Part B`, cost $200.00, markup 25%, qty 1, supplier "Widgets Ltd". App-computed price: **$250.00** (parts total $375.00).

**4. Part A cost changed 100 → 150 — DONE.** Row now reads `fwrd93-n1 RD Part A | $150.00 | 25% | 1 | Widgets Ltd | $187.50`. App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (parts total $437.50; Part B unchanged at $250.00).

**5. Status Ready — DONE.** Clicked "Mark Ready" on RD-1015; status changed Draft → **Ready** and persisted on a fresh reload (buttons became "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed"). No refusal occurred for this ticket because its preconditions were already satisfied.

**Preconditions discovered** (via a throwaway probe ticket RD-1016, which I created, tested, and then archived): the app refuses "Mark Ready" with the alert **"Ticket is not ready — A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready"** when the ticket has no parts, and with **"Ticket is not ready — Part \"fwrd93-n1 RD Probe Part\" has no supplier"** when a part lacks a supplier. So the enforced requirements are: **(a) the ticket must have at least one part, and (b) every part must have a supplier.** RD-1015 satisfied both at the time (two parts, both with supplier "Widgets Ltd"), so no extra action was needed.

**6. Parts removed and ticket archived — DONE.** Deleted both parts via each row's Delete action with the in-app "Confirm" → "Delete part" dialog; the parts table then showed only "No parts on this ticket yet." with no total row. Then clicked "Archive ticket" (no confirmation dialog; button became "Unarchive ticket") and the detail page shows an **"Archived"** badge alongside Status "Ready". In the default tickets list (Show archived unchecked, "Showing 1–10 of 13") neither RD-1015 nor the probe ticket RD-1016 appears — both are visible only under the "Show archived" filter. Final read-only check of `/#/tickets/t15` confirmed: title `fwrd93-n1 RD Bench Ticket`, Status **Ready**, **Archived** badge present, 0 parts, buttons Mark Draft / Mark Closed / Unarchive ticket / Add part.

Nothing created by this run remains active.
